## Activity

Market Eye Clinic completed 377 captures during December 2021. Activity was delivered through the scheduled clinic sessions, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading results reported below. No further operational issues were identified in the available report.

## Image quality

There were 17 ungradable captures. This represented an ungradable rate of 4.5 per cent. The result is noted for routine monitoring of image acquisition and review processes. The ungradable captures should continue to be considered when assessing the overall performance of the service and identifying any requirement for operational follow-up.

## Grading

A total of 81 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 17 days. This indicates the time between capture and completion of grading for the middle result in the reporting period. The referable results and grading interval should be reviewed alongside the activity and image quality measures to support ongoing service oversight at Market Eye Clinic.
